# Workbench icon asset

Lucide 0.468.0 is the same version previously loaded from the CDN. The workbench
now ships the upstream minified UMD distribution unchanged and uses system font
fallbacks instead of requesting Google Fonts. No package manager or network
access is needed when opening the installed workbench.
